sec: sec:C004: Prevent out-of-scope outputs / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:C004: Prevent out-of-scope outputs / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Detecting and blocking out-of-scope requests. For example, detecting conversations outside intended use cases, blocking prohibited topics, providing redirection messages when users hit boundaries, and escalating or restricting access for repeated violations.

sentences.text: For example, detecting conversations outside intended use cases, blocking prohibited topics, providing redirection messages when users hit boundaries, and escalating or restricting access for repeated violations.

blocks.id: blk:C004: Prevent out-of-scope outputs / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Tracking out-of-scope violations and updating boundaries. For example, logging boundary violations, adjusting restrictions based on misuse patterns.
